raw.details:
First of all join the official WhatsApp group (after registration): DEFCON 2.0 OFFICIAL

Hello, Hacker!

DEFCON 2.0 is a four-hour, team-based Attack-Defense CTF hosted by HAM ARC Technical Club, NIT Warangal. Exploit vulnerabilities, protect your systems, outsmart rival teams, and fight for the top spot.

️ The Battlefield

  • Attack: Find vulnerabilities, exploit systems, and complete objectives to score points.
  • Defend: Detect intrusions, patch weaknesses, and keep your services secure.
  • Outscore: Balance offense and defense to stay ahead on the leaderboard.

Expect hands-on cybersecurity challenges, live attack-and-defense gameplay, and a competition where every team's systems are targets.

Exciting Prizes & Classified Goodies

Compete for bragging rights and exciting rewards, including potential AI and coding-tool subscriptions. More details remain classified!

Event Details

  • Organiser: HAM ARC Technical Club, NIT Warangal
  • Venue: NIT Warangal, Hanamkonda District, Telangana – 506004
  • Date: 30 October 2026
  • Duration: 4 hours
  • Team Size: 1–4 participants

Whether you're new to CTFs, an experienced CTF player or an aspiring security researcher, bring your skills, build your strategy, and prove yourself in the arena.

ATTACK | DEFEND | DOMINATE

Register now. Dominate the arena.
